## Runtime Data Boundary Audit — Classification Report

### IMMUTABLE LEDGERS (append-only, never truncate or overwrite)

These are the authoritative historical records. They must never be pruned or modified; they grow monotonically.

| Path | Schema / Purpose |
|---|---|
| `data/events.ndjson` | Root subagent lifecycle event stream (SubagentStart/Stop per agent) |
| `data/lifecycle/events.ndjson` | Lifecycle supervisor close-request audit stream |
| `data/lifecycle/name_map.jsonl` | Append-only agent nickname→task_name mapping log |
| `data/lifecycle/close_requests.ndjson` | Append-only close-request drain log |
| `data/budget/events.ndjson` | Budget allocation/reclamation event stream |
| `data/usage/token_ledger.ndjsonl` | Per-step token usage ledger with idempotency keys (`idem_key`) — primary metering source of truth |
| `data/router/route_ledger.ndjsonl` | Per-packet routing decision log with confidence and features |
| `data/governor/state_attestations.ndjsonl` | Governor state transition attestations (idem-keyed) |
| `data/governor/layered_gate.ndjsonl` | Per-check layered-gate evaluation log |
| `data/escalation_log.jsonl` | SOL_WAKE / escalation events pointing to sol_wake summaries |
| `data/lessons.jsonl` | Cross-task lesson accumulator (empty in current session, but append-only by design) |
| `data/reports/headless-wave/**/events.jsonl` | Per-agent execution event streams from headless workers — terminal record of each agent's work |

---

### IMMUTABLE POINT-IN-TIME SNAPSHOTS (write-once per task/wave)

These files are written once when a task or wave concludes and are not subsequently updated in place. They serve as durable records of terminal outcomes.

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `data/packets/parent-*.json` | Task packet definitions (goal/acceptance/constraints) — written at planning time, never mutated |
| `data/lifecycle_reports/parent-*/report.json` | Terminal lifecycle report per parent session |
| `data/dead_letters/*.json` | Off-table / DEAD_LETTER event records (written once on failure) |
| `data/sol_wake/<ts>_*.md` | Sol wake summary documents (written once per escalation event) |
| `data/duty_review/parent-*.json` | Duty review records for specific parent sessions |
| `data/repairs/transport-deadletters-*/repair_manifest.json` | Repair operation manifest |
| `data/repairs/transport-deadletters-*/progress_ledger.before.json` | Pre-repair state snapshot |
| `data/repairs/transport-deadletters-*/progress_ledger.after.json` | Post-repair state snapshot |
| `data/reports/headless-wave/**/last_message.txt` | Final message from each headless agent (immutable once written) |

---

### TTL-ELIGIBLE MUTABLE STATE (overwritten in place; safe to evict/reset when idle)

These files are continuously overwritten by running processes. Their freshness is the value, not their history.

**Live concurrency / refill state**

| Path | TTL Rationale |
|---|---|
| `data/refill/refill_state.json` | Rebuilt every refill loop iteration; stale after session end |
| `data/refill/work_queue.json` | Queue drain state; empty queue = content is stale |
| `data/refill/spawn_throttle_state.json` | Birth-rate throttle counters; meaningful only during active spawning |
| `data/refill/parent_sessions.json` | Active parent session registry; stale when no parent is running |
| `data/refill/parent_watch_status.json` | Watch-loop heartbeat state |
| `data/refill/packet_wave.json` | Current wave manifest pointer |
| `data/orchestration/epilogue_status.json` | Last epilogue run result — overwritten each epilogue |
| `data/orchestration/terminal_packet_status.json` | Current terminal sweep counters — overwritten each sweep |
| `data/orchestration/refill_requests.json` | Sequence-numbered refill request cursor — updated in place |
| `data/orchestration/terminal_requests.json` | Sequence-numbered terminal request cursor — updated in place |
| `data/lifecycle/native_roster.json` | Live snapshot of Desktop-native agents; reconciled on each cold start |
| `data/lifecycle/exec_roster.json` | Live snapshot of headless exec jobs; rebuilt each wave |

**Provider / governor runtime state**

| Path | TTL Rationale |
|---|---|
| `data/provider_health/k3.json` | Last health probe result + backoff window; meaningful only while probing |
| `data/provider_health/route-*.json` | Per-route health record; stale after route is no longer active |
| `data/governor/model_profile.json` | Currently active model profile; overwritten on profile switch |
| `data/governor/layered_authorization.json` | Last full gate-check snapshot; refreshed before each birth |
| `data/governor/rollback_rehearsal.json` | Last rollback rehearsal result — refreshed periodically |

**Usage / metering derived state**

| Path | TTL Rationale |
|---|---|
| `data/usage/model_token_share.json` | Computed share ratios (v1 bridge); regenerated each epilogue |
| `data/usage/model_token_share_v2.json` | v2 computed share ratios; regenerated each epilogue |
| `data/usage/windows_model_token_share.json` | Windows-plane specific share snapshot |
| `data/usage/meter_bridge_state.json` | Meter-bridge scan result (records, duplicates, status); overwritten each scan |
| `data/usage/hysteresis_state.json` | Budget hysteresis (above/below/state counters); overwritten in place |
| `data/usage/run_role_map.json` | Agent-ID→role/model lookup table; rebuilt from ledger on demand |
| `data/usage/meter_shadow_comparison.json` | Shadow comparison result artifact |

**L2 queue liveness signals**

| Path | TTL Rationale |
|---|---|
| `data/l2_queue/consumer_heartbeat.json` | Consumer process liveness timestamp + PID; stale after ~120 s |
| `data/l2_queue/exactly_once_canary.json` | Canary pass/fail status; updated each canary check |

**Smoke / validators (derived, per-run)**

| Path | TTL Rationale |
|---|---|
| `data/smoke/plan-pipeline-*.json` / `*.jsonl` / `*.log` | Smoke test artifacts for the current/last run; regenerated on each smoke |
| `data/validators/short_result_validator.json` | Validator enable flag state; overwritten when validator config changes |

**Refill ad-hoc audit outputs (per-day)**

| Path | TTL Rationale |
|---|---|
| `data/refill/p0_readonly_audit_headless_20260814.*` | Ad-hoc audit run artifacts for 2026-08-14; safe to evict after 7 days |
| `data/refill/p0_visibility_followup_20260814.*` | Follow-up audit artifacts; same policy |
| `data/refill/p0_sustained_final_review.json` | Final review snapshot from ad-hoc review run |
| `data/refill/root_non_ipybox_audit_headless_20260814.json` | Per-day audit snapshot |
| `data/refill/parent-019f*.json` | Per-parent backlog/audit artifacts (stale once parent finishes) |
| `data/orchestration/sonnet-*.txt` | Model probe response artifacts; stale after probe |

---

### LOCK AND TEMP FILES (process-owned, discard if owning process is dead)

| Pattern | Notes |
|---|---|
| `**/*.lock` | Advisory file locks — safe to remove when no live process holds them |
| `**/*.tmp.<pid>` (e.g. `exec_roster.json.38772.tmp`) | Atomic-rename temp files — orphaned if PID is not running; safe to delete |
| `data/orchestration/epilogue_status.json.tmp.36244` | Same: orphaned atomic-rename temp |

---

**Summary:** The 12 append-only NDJSON/JSONL event streams and per-packet write-once JSON files under `data/packets/`, `data/dead_letters/`, `data/sol_wake/`, `data/lifecycle_reports/`, and `data/repairs/` are immutable ledgers that must never be cleaned. Everything in the live-state group (rosters, refill state, provider health, metering snapshots, smoke artifacts, heartbeats, canary, hysteresis) is TTL-eligible once the owning process is idle or a configurable retention window (suggested: 7 days for dated ad-hoc artifacts, session-end for concurrency state). Lock and `.tmp.<pid>` files are process-owned and can be reaped whenever the owning PID is confirmed dead.
